name: Electronics Emoji
description: EVENT: SYMBOLS — 81 schematic symbol modules and their 18px and 72px renders, plus the proposal arguing them into Unicode. Two doors: gallery.htm is the lookup, index.html is the paper, and index.html is laid out for letter paper rather than a screen. The modules are ES modules, so both doors need server.py running — a file:// open shows an empty grid and no error.
